lines: Japan has launched a mission to bring back a piece of a Martian moon.
The spacecraft, called M M X, lifted off on an H3 rocket on October nineteenth.
It should reach Mars in August twenty twenty-seven, and land on the moon Phobos twice.
The goal is to return about ten grams of soil to Earth in twenty thirty-one.
It would be the first sample ever brought back from the Mars system.
